result.topic_en: Opening of the section 'Old unsolved questions', with the heading 'Questions of Mannheim' and the beginning of question 820 (1867, p. 335) on a plane section of a quadric surface and four points on the intersection curve.
result.transcription:
ANCIENNES QUESTIONS NON RESOLUES.

Questions de Mannheim.

820 (1867, 335). — On coupe une surface du second degré (S)
par un plan. On prend, sur la courbe d'intersection C, quatre
points arbitraires (non en ligne droite) $a$, $b$, $g$, $h$, et l'on

questions.statement_en: A surface of the second degree (S) is cut by a plane. On the curve of intersection C one takes four arbitrary points (not in a straight line) $a$, $b$, $g$, $h$, and one
